subject: chemistry
content: When 3.06 g of solid NH<sub>4</sub>HS is introduced into a two litre evacuated flask at 27<sup>o</sup> C, 30% of the solid decomposes into gaseous ammonia and hydrogen sulphide. (i) K<sub>c</sub> and K<sub>p</sub> for the reaction at 27<sup>o</sup> C<sub></sub> (ii) What would happen to the equilibrium when more solid NH<sub>4</sub>HS is introduced into the flask?
